content.title: Did the USMNT win today? Results from game vs. Belgium
content.text: Live updates: USMNT vs. BelgiumBelow the photo gallery, the Times Union provided updates before, during and after the game.Belgium's Jeremy Doku and Belgium's Dodi Lukebakio celebrate during a friendly soccer game between the United States national team and Belgian national soccer team Red Devils in Atlanta, on Saturday 28 March 2026, in preparation for the 2026 World Cup. BELGA PHOTO DIRK WAEM (Photo by DIRK WAEM / BELGA MAG / Belga / AFP via Getty Images)DIRK WAEM/BELGA MAG/AFP via Getty Images Final: Belgium 5, USMNT 2 5:45 p.m.: That's a wrap for today as the USMNT loses 5-2 to Belgium in the Americans' first game of 2026.Article continues below this ad Patrick Agyemang scores for USMNT 5:28 p.m.: Ricardo Pepi forces a turnover deep in Belgium's defensive zone and the ball finds Patrick Agyemang, who scores to trim Belgium's lead to 5-2 in the 87th minute. Dodi Lukébakio scores again 5:25 p.m.: Dodi Lukébakio scores his second goal of the half to give Belgium a 5-1 lead with under 10 minutes left. Very nonchalant defense from the USMNT on the play as Lukébakio recovered a turnover in the box to easily slot the ball past USMNT keeper Matt Turner.Article continues below this ad Gio Reyna enters game 5:15 p.m.: Some changes in the 70th minute as Gio Reyna replaces Weston McKennie for the USMNT. Dodi Lukébakio scores for Belgium 5:10 p.m.: Dodi Lukébakio scores on a beautiful shot from just outside the box as Belgium now leads 4-1 in the 70th minute. It's the third goal in the half for Belgium as the wheels have completely fallen off for the USMNT.Article continues below this ad Charles De Ketelaere scores for Belgium 5:01 p.m.: Belgium's Charles De Ketelaere calmly steps to the penalty line and deposits the ball into the upper left of the goal as Belgium now leads 3-1 in the 59th minute. USMNT called for handball in the box 5 p.m.: USMNT defender Tim Ream is called for a handball in the box and after VAR review, Belgium is awarded a penalty kick.Article continues below this ad Amadou Onana scores for Belgium 4:55 p.m.: Belgium takes a 2-1 lead in the 53rd minute on a goal from Amadou Onana, beautifully assisted by Charles De Ketelaere. The goal was set up by Jeremy Doku, who has been giving the USMNT defense fits. Who is Cristian Roldan? 4:50 p.m.: USMNT midfielder Cristian Roldan has become a favorite of head coach Mauricio Pochettino for his work ethic and willingness to accept a reserve role. After a two-year absence from the national team following the 2023 Gold Cup, Roldan has experienced a resurgence, recording two assists in a 2-1 win over Australia in Oct. 2025 and gaining momentum toward a 2026 roster call-up.Article continues below this ad Second half underway 4:45 p.m.: The second half is underway as Cristian Roldan replaces Johnny Cardoso for the USMNT. Why is Tyler Adams not playing today? 4:40 p.m.: The USMNT is missing one of its key midfield playmakers – Tyler Adams. After working his way back from tearing his meniscus in December, the midfielder suffered a hamstring injury in training with his professional team, Bournemouth, and will be sidelined until early April. Article continues below this ad Half: USMNT 1, Belgium 1 4:30 p.m.: Weston McKennie gave the U.S. a 1-0 lead late in the first half, but Belgium responded on a goal in the 45th minute by Zeno Debast to level the game 1-1 going into halftime. USMNT goalkeeper Matt Turner has been stellar, turning back several strong chances for Belgium. 4:25 p.m.: Belgium levels the score 1-1 on a goal by Zeno Debast from outside the box in the 45th minute. Belgium has turned up the intensity towards the end of the half, hammering the U.S. defense with close-range shots.Article continues below this ad Weston McKennie scores 4:17 p.m.: Weston McKennie gets the U.S. on the board first, scoring after a perfectly placed corner kick from Antonee Robinson in the 39th minute. Christian Pulisic, Weston McKennie 4:15 p.m.: USMNT teammates Christian Pulisic and Weston McKennie have played together since they represented the U.S. at the U-15 youth level and made their debuts with the senior team in consecutive years – Pulisic on March 29, 2016, and McKennie on Nov. 14, 2017.Article continues below this adBoth players are having strong seasons in the Italian Serie A. Pulisic has eight goals for AC Milan, while McKennie has four for Juventus. The 27-year-old veterans represent the core leadership group of the USMNT and come into today’s game with a combined 144 caps with the senior team. USMNT vs. Belgium scoreless 4:05 p.m.: The USMNT and Belgium are scoreless midway through the first half in Atlanta. Belgium has maintained a slight edge in possession, while the teams have both registered six shots in the game. Article continues below this ad Weston McKennie issued yellow card 4 p.m.: USMNT midfielder Weston McKennie is shown a yellow card after a hard tackle in the 19th minute as teams head to the sideline to rehydrate. Matt Turner denies Belgium 3:57 p.m.: USMNT goalie Matt Turner denies Belgium on a point-blank shot by Zeno Debast in the 18th minute. Impressive reflexes from the veteran keeper. Article continues below this ad Christian Pulisic gets a shot off 3:54 p.m.: Christian Pulisic misses on a shot from outside the box. Antonee Robinson launches powerful strike 3:48 p.m.: The USMNT is generating some early offense here. A header from Christian Pulisic sails over the crossbar after a beautiful cross from Tim Weah and Antonee Robinson follows with a laser from just outside the penalty box, saved by Belgium goalie Senne Lammens in the ninth minute.Article continues below this ad USMNT vs. Belgium underway 3:39 p.m.: The game is underway as Belgium takes the kick-off from midfield. Aidan Fisher plays national anthem 3:35 p.m.: Aidan Fisher plays the "Star-Spangled Banner" on the electric guitar. The Atlanta native appeared in an episode of the hit Netflix show "Stranger Things." Article continues below this ad USMNT in 2025 3:30 p.m.: The U.S. finished 2025 strong, with an 8-2-2 record over its final 12 matches, capped by a 5-1 rout over two-time World Cup winner Uruguay in the fall. A total of 56 players earned at least one cap with the team in 2025, with senior team debuts from current squad members Patrick Agyemang, Max Arfsten, Sebastian Berhalter, Alex Freeman and Matt Freese. Chris Richards, Miles Robinson nursing injuries 3:20 p.m.: The U.S. will be without two key defenders for its upcoming friendlies against Belgium and Portugal. Miles Robinson will miss both matches because of a groin injury and Chris Richards will likely sit out both games with a knee injury. Robinson injured his groin during training on Tuesday and Richards arrived at camp with an injury sustained while playing for his pro team, Crystal Palace.Article continues below this ad Kevin De Bruyne in Belgium's starting XI 3:10 p.m.: Here's a look at Belgium's starting lineup, headlined by midfielder Kevin De Bruyne. 1-Senne Lammens 4-Brandon Mechele 2-Zeno Debast 5-Maxim De Cuyper 15-Thomas Meunier 7-Kevin De Bruyne 24-Amadou Onana 23-Nicolas Raskin 17-Charles De Ketelaere 11-Jérémy Doku 22-Alexis Saelemaekers Substitutes: 8-Youri Tielemans, 20-Nathan Ngoy, 12-Maarten Vandevoordt, 16-Koni De Winter, 3-Arthur Theate, 21-Timothy Castagne, 18-Joaquin Seys, 9-Loïs Openda, 14-Dodi Lukebakio, 25-Nathan De Cat, 26-Mika Godts, 19-Lucas Stassin, 6-Axel Witsel, 13-Matz Sels.Article continues below this ad Tim Ream wears captain's armband 3 p.m.: USMNT defender Tim Ream will wear the captain’s armband for the 26th time overall and 11th time in the team’s last 13 matches. Ream is a veteran leader and has served as the team's primary captain for the past year. He started every match at the 2022 World Cup and led the U.S. to the 2025 Gold Cup Final, playing more than 900 minutes for the national team in the calendar year. USMNT starting lineup today 2:45 p.m.: A look at the starting lineup for the USMNT against Belgium and bench options for head coach Mauricio Pochettino.Article continues below this ad 1-Matt Turner 5-Antonee Robinson 6-Tanner Tessmann 8-Weston McKennie 10-Christian Pulisic 13-Tim Ream (captain) 15-Johnny Cardoso 17-Malik Tillman 20-Folarin Balogun 21-Tim Weah 22-Mark McKenzie Substitutes: 24-Matt Freese, 26-Chris Brady, 27-Patrick Schulte, 2-Auston Trusty, 4-Cristian Roldan, 7-Gio Reyna, 9-Ricardo Pepi, 11-Brenden Aaronson, 14-Sebastian Berhalter, 16-Alex Freeman, 18-Max Arfsten, 19-Joe Scally, 23-Aidan Morris, 25-Patrick AgyemangNot Dressed: 3-Chris Richards, 12-Miles Robinson
